min_fan_speed.description: Minimum allowed fan speed as a percentage (0–100). Prevents fans from stopping entirely.

max_fan_speed.description: Maximum allowed fan speed as a percentage (0–100).

passive_cooling.description: If true, reduce CPU frequency instead of increasing fan speed when hot.

force_fan_control.description: If true, override SMC auto-fan-control and force manual control.

name.description: Sensor name (as reported by SMC, e.g., 'TC0D', 'TB0T').

fan.description: Fan identifier (e.g., 'F0Ac', 'F1Ac') to associate with this sensor.

threshold.description: Optional temperature threshold (°C) — leave blank to use zone-based thresholds.

zones.description: List of temperature zones with thresholds and associated fans.

thresholds.description: Temperature thresholds (°C) in ascending order; each triggers fan speed change.

fans.description: Fan identifiers corresponding to each threshold.

overrides.description: Optional list of explicit fan speed overrides (disables automatic control for those fans).

speed.description: Fan speed as percentage (0–100) for this override.
